name: NOAHS_ARK
canonical: Noah's ark: a colossal rectangular chest-like wooden ark built of pitch-blackened gopher-wood planks, shaped like an enormous flat-sided floating BOX with a long low pitched gable roof running its whole length and a SINGLE large square doorway set high in one long flat side — NOT a sailing ship, NOT a boat with a curved or pointed hull, NOT a shed, cabin or house, resting whole upon dry land, shown in full from the side so the one high door, the long box hull and the roof are all clearly visible
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
